Mushihimesama Futari Ver. 1.5 (recompiled) - family & friends test build
Xbox 360 (2006/2012) statically recompiled for PC. This build INCLUDES the game
data so it just runs - which is exactly why it is private. Please don't pass it
on or upload it anywhere; a public build (without the data) comes later.

TO PLAY
  Unzip anywhere and double-click futari.exe. A window opens; logs go to
  logs\futari_NNN.log next to the exe.

DLC
  The add-on content is in the dlc\ folder and installs itself on first launch -
  nothing to do.

REQUIREMENTS
  - Windows 10/11 x64 with a Direct3D 12 GPU
  - Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64):
      https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe

CONTROLS
  An Xbox controller works out of the box (PlayStation and most other pads work
  too). Keyboard is also enabled (gameplay and menus): arrows/WASD = move,
  Space = A, Shift = B, Enter = Start, Tab = Back. Press F4 for the settings
  overlay to rebind keys or turn keyboard mode off. The mouse cursor stays free.

SETTINGS
  Edit futari.ini (next to the exe) for resolution, fullscreen, vsync, upscaler,
  and log level, then restart. The F4 overlay's "Save to config" writes into the
  same futari.ini, updating those lines in place (your comments survive). Saves
  and shader cache default to Documents\futari; set user_data_path / cache_path
  in futari.ini to relocate them (a relative path like "saves" keeps everything
  next to the exe for a portable build).

TESTING - WHAT TO REPORT
  Anything that looks wrong: a crash, a freeze, garbled graphics or audio, a
  setting that doesn't stick. Send the newest file from logs\ with a line or
  two about what you were doing. Playing normally for a while IS the test.

LICENCES
  This build links third-party open-source components (including FFmpeg and
  libmspack under the LGPL-2.1). Their licences, and the LGPL's written offer of
  source, are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt beside this file.

Built with heavy use of AI tooling. Hobby project, no warranty. Cave own all
rights to Mushihimesama Futari.
